description: Locate the (x, y) center of a UI element on the local screen by its visible text label. Runs OCR (tesseract.js) and returns word-level bounding boxes. Set `fuzzy: true` to allow ~85% similarity matches (handles OCR noise). Use `nth` to pick among multiple matches.

fuzzy.description: Allow ~85% similarity match instead of exact substring (default false).

nth.description: Return the Nth matching element (1-indexed, default 1).

name: jrd_find_element
